_about: Starting points for the FDOP Workbench taken from the current signed FDOPs. Values here win over the 2026 thresholds sheet when the Workbench opens an FDRA; users can change everything from there.

STF-348.source: Sierra South Interagency FDOP (signed 2023-03-20, v. 2023-05-05), Appendix 2
STF-348.notes: Manager-modified ERC-Y bins used in 2022 (FFP initial bins 0-46, 47-59, 60-72, 73-76, 77+). Large fire = 10 ac final size; multi-fire day = 2+ starts.

STF-370.source: Sierra South Interagency FDOP (signed 2023-03-20, v. 2023-05-05), Appendix 3
STF-370.notes: Manager-modified ERC-Y bins (FFP initial 0-34, 35-44, 45-63, 64-66, 67+). Large fire = 20 ac; multi-fire day = 2+.

SNF-533.source: Sierra South Interagency FDOP (signed 2023-03-20, v. 2023-05-05), Appendix 4
SNF-533.notes: Very High = 75th percentile = ERC 52; Extreme = 95th percentile = ERC 57 (2010-2020, Jun 15-Oct 1). Covers STF, YNP and SNF high country.

BDF-660.source: San Bernardino NF 2023 FDOP Vol. 1, Table 13
BDF-660.notes: BI fire business thresholds for dispatch levels (1-75 Low, 76-124 Moderate, 125-175 High, 176-212 High, >212 High 2nd alarm). Large fire = 30 ac+.

BDF-670.source: San Bernardino NF 2023 FDOP Vol. 1, Table 9 (SIG)

BDF-673.source: San Bernardino NF 2023 FDOP Vol. 1, Table 10 (SIG)

BDF-692.source: San Bernardino NF 2023 FDOP Vol. 1, Table 11 (SIG)

BDF-694.source: San Bernardino NF 2023 FDOP Vol. 1, Table 12 (SIG)

ANF-Front Country.notes: FDRA average of the per-station Fire Family Plus breakpoints (BI Low/Mod/High/VH/Extreme = 38/92/147/225/271; ERC 16.6/33.6/55.2/93/109.4). Per-station values: Claremont, Clear Creek, Little Tujunga, Santa Fe, Tanbark.

ANF-High Country.notes: FDRA averages of per-station breakpoints (BI 69/119/187/239/290; ERC 5.7/47/70.7/96/108). Stations Big Pines, Chilao, Mill Creek.

ANF-Saugus.notes: FDRA averages of per-station breakpoints (BI 43/110/182/247/304; ERC 19.8/39.5/74.2/99.8/107.5). Stations Acton, Grass Mtn, Mill Creek, Valyermo, Warm Springs Mtn, Whitaker Peak.
